item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 28/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Bualoi will move across the seas south of Hainan Island today, towards the northern part of Vietnam. Under the combined effect of the ridge of high pressure over the coast of southeastern China and Bualoi, it is expected to be windy with a few showers over the coast of southern China today. Seas will be rough with swells. An anticyclone aloft will cover Guangdong in the next few days, the weather will be fine and very hot over the region.

Date/Month: 28/09 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5. Occasionally force 6 offshore at first, up to force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Sunny intervals during the day. Isolated thunderstorms later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium
